purpose: Define the auditable dataset boundary between administered task instances, immutable raw observations, C3 coding records and reproducible pilot analysis.
rules: Every observation must reference exactly one administered task instance.
The observation task_id must equal the referenced task instance task_id.
Learner, study, session, wave and registry version must agree between observation and task instance.
Observation IDs, task-instance IDs and coding IDs must be unique within the dataset snapshot.
A coding record may reference only an existing observation.
The same coder may not create two records for the same observation and coding round.
Independent coder records remain separate; adjudication is a separate record and never replaces the originals.
No dataset validator may infer mastery, developmental position, prerequisite status, causal inference, curriculum promotion or next action.
The dataset is a research/test boundary and is not a runtime mastery store.

snapshot.ordering: Deterministic ordering by learner_id, observed_at, observation_id for observations; coding_id for coding records; task_instance_id for task instances.
snapshot.purpose: Reproducible exports and analysis inputs without changing source observations.

supabase.reason: This layer validates pure dataset structure and referential integrity; it does not change persistence schema or write learner data.

scientific_boundary: A structurally valid dataset is not evidence that a developmental claim is true. C4/C5 inference remains gated by the pre-specified protocols.
